tasks.goal: CLI telemetryを改行しないescaped一行として表示
tasks.interface: Preserve existing signatures, surrounding source and all protected tests. Implement telemetry_line(warning: &str) -> String: escape each backslash as two backslashes, LF as literal backslash-n, CR as backslash-r, TAB as backslash-t. Preserve all other Unicode characters and spaces exactly, with no trimming or extra prefix. Empty input returns empty. Process original characters once, without re-escaping newly inserted escape characters. Only individual CLI display changes; audit/source input is unchanged.
